review_context.label_policy: Low-IoU crops are accepted as ped only when the source overlay and the 32x32 crop both show the same single pedestrian; ambiguous or severely truncated crops would be ignore.
review_context.boundary: This is a short, consecutive validation-scene diagnostic window containing one pedestrian track. It is correlated evidence and is not imported wholesale into training.
